title: Feedback vertex sets in oriented graphs
summary: For an oriented graph $G$, denote by $fvs(G)$ the minimum number of vertices whose deletion from $G$ makes it acyclic. We show that an oriented graph $G$ on $n$ vertices and $m$ arcs satisfies $fvs(G) \le \frac{2n+m+h}{9}$ where $h$ denotes the number of connected components of $G$ that belong to a special class of oriented graphs. This result has three consequences. First, when $G$ is planar, we obtain that $fvs(G) \le \frac{2n+m}{9}$.
